root_cause: Placement-class failure: sense net /SENSEC2_LO is fragmented (2 islands, 15 foreign crossings) due to components or vias cutting the copper pour. This creates DRC violations and over-temp flags. More routing cannot fix a bad placement; the corridor-avoid lever and panel effort will carry it, but T0 placement actuator does not fire because kelvin_ok=true (no stranded sense net).
reasoning: The pour-integrity data shows /SENSEC2_LO has 2 islands and 15 foreign crossings, indicating the sense copper is broken by foreign signals. This is a placement issue: sensitive bodies (INA/REF) likely sit in the high-current band, fragmenting the sense net. The DRC count of 14 and over-temp flags on SENSEC nets confirm the thermal and routing impact. Since kelvin_ok=true, the T0 actuator will not shift parts; the corridor-avoid lever and panel effort are the only active levers.

proposed_lever.description: Evict sense-related components (INA/REF) from the /SENSEC2_LO corridor to reduce foreign crossings and consolidate islands. This is advisory; T0 will not fire automatically because kelvin_ok=true.
